observedFailure: The waking renderer's newly created MediaQueryList missed its change notification in one trial. Other identical queries received the event. The actual preference became reduced, drawing stopped at source frame 1 and the native clock later finished without a phase completion callback.
fix: The drawing loop now checks actual availability and invokes the same safe still-pose settlement when motion becomes unavailable. It no longer relies only on the change notification.
regression: The browser suite suppresses reduced-motion change listeners in a separate context and requires waking to return to a usable static launcher, without another sleep or a model request.
